speaker: alse_pinder
text: You are early, which in this house means I have not yet cut anything I promised not to cut. Hands are cold. The basin is not set. She said noon, not the minute you came through the door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Noon can keep the basin. I want the stair and the quiet, and I will not be proved in the passage.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Gib has moved. He was on the tread when you left, and he is on the Holinshed now, and the book is shut, which is his whole opinion of reading. I looked, because of the bundle.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The bundle stays where it was tied. If he is on the chronicle, he is not on the bundle, and that is the better of the two sins.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The broth is on the side, keeping. I am not bringing it up. Dinner is a table, not a tray, and she has views.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep it at the table. I will come down when she cuts the loaf, and not before, unless the cat learns to turn pages.
